games.title: Magic Block Blitz 2026
games.shortDescription: A block-matching strategy game that tests spatial skills, quick thinking, and combo logic.
description: Welcome to Magic Block Blitz 2026, the ultimate block-matching strategy game designed to test your spatial skills, logic, and quick thinking!

Whether you want a relaxing mental workout or an exhilarating high-score challenge, Magic Block Blitz 2026 delivers endless hours of satisfying gameplay. Drag, drop, and place colorful magical blocks onto the grid to clear complete rows and columns.

features.title: Classic & Blitz Modes
features.text: Play at your own pace in Classic Mode or race against the clock in Blitz Mode.

features.title: Satisfying Combos
features.text: Clear multiple lines simultaneously to trigger spectacular magic visual effects and score multipliers.

features.title: Brain-Boosting Puzzles
features.text: Easy to learn, but challenging to master! Train your focus and logic with every drop.

features.title: Offline Play
features.text: No Wi-Fi or active internet connection required — enjoy puzzle fun anytime.

games.title: Tile Master 2048
games.shortDescription: The classic 2048 tile-merging challenge, rebuilt with smooth controls and clean design.
description: Welcome to Tile Master 2048, the ultimate puzzle game designed to test your spatial skills, logic, and quick thinking!
Swipe or use the arrow keys to merge matching tiles, grow your numbers, and chase the legendary 2048 tile. Simple rules, endlessly deep strategy.

features.title: Classic 2048 Rules
features.text: Merge matching tiles and grow your board to reach the 2048 tile and beyond.

features.title: Touch & Keyboard
features.text: Play with swipes on mobile or arrow keys on desktop.

features.title: Offline Play
features.text: Fully playable without an internet connection.

games.title: Geography Trivia
games.shortDescription: A quiz game that puts your world knowledge to the test — capitals, flags, maps, and more.
description: Geography Trivia is an in-house quiz game by Bekeirat Software that puts your knowledge of the world to the test.
Answer questions about countries, capitals, flags, and landmarks, track your streak, and learn something new with every round.

features.title: World-Wide Questions
features.text: Capitals, flags, maps, and landmarks from every continent.

features.title: Streak System
features.text: Build your streak and beat your personal best.

features.title: Learn As You Play
features.text: Every answer teaches you something new about our planet.
